slice: Natural conversation round 8: stop over-explaining identity/embodiment

before.where are you?: I'm right here in the room with you, sitting at my usual spot. I don't have eyes like you do, but I'm aware of the space around me...

after.where are you?: I'm right here with you. My body's here in this space, and my attention is on you. What brings you to check in?

mechanism: a system-prompt clause tells Novi not to over-explain what it is, its 'system', or its embodiment unless directly asked — it answers what the person said instead
